scope: physical profile ownership and legacy journal exclusion; synthetic-only backend validation
constructor: Legacy StateDir lock remains first. A defer cancels lifecycle and closes physical lock if present plus legacy lock on every later constructor error. Invalid-journal test exercises post-acquisition failure and independent reacquisition of both lock files.
close: Close cancels work and persists disposition, unlocks mutex, waits wg, then releases physical lock followed by legacy lock. Original fake operation join and focused race pass.
lockOrder: Both flock acquisitions are nonblocking; physical-lock contention returns through constructor cleanup, releasing its already-acquired legacy lock.
alias: OS inode identity provides exclusion for tested Home symlink alias; distinct-StateDir and separate Go-process cases reject the same Home/Profile and permit acquisition after Close.
compatibility: Original same-StateDir rejection and restart/no-blind-retry test retained; journal remains in StateDir. No unsupported Windows/provider/driver contract added.
limits: No actual minikube CLI/global CLI lock behavior tested.
No new worker/UI/E2E or historical pending-journal recovery acceptance.
